
== CreateDatabase acme_x7k2_shop
steps: Create database | Create user | Allow the website container only
long: false
$ install -d -o root -g root -m 0711 $DIR/cf-db $DIR/cf-db/servers $DIR/cf-db/homes
$ chmod 0700 $DIR/cf-db/homes/db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1
$ loginctl enable-linger db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1
$ systemctl start user@10001.service
$ install -d -o root -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -m 0750 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1
$ install -d -o root -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -m 0750 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1/disk
$ install -d -o db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -m 0700 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1/disk/data
$ chown root:db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1/mariadb.env
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman image exists ghcr.io/cloudfactory/mariadb:latest
$ systemctl --user --machine=db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1@ daemon-reload
$ systemctl --user --machine=db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1@ restart cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1.service
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb-admin --protocol=tcp --host=127.0.0.1 --port=3306 --connect-timeout=5 ping
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | SELECT 1;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | CREATE DATABASE `acme_x7k2_shop` CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | SELECT 1 FROM mysql.user WHERE User = 'acme_x7k2_shop';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | CREATE USER 'acme_x7k2_shop'@'169.254.80.1' IDENTIFIED BY 'Abcdefghijklmnop1234' REQUIRE NONE WITH MAX_USER_CONNECTIONS 100;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON `acme\_x7k2\_shop`.* TO 'acme_x7k2_shop'@'169.254.80.1';

== CreateDatabase acme_x7k2_blog
steps: Create database | Create user | Allow the website container only
long: false
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | CREATE DATABASE `acme_x7k2_blog` CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | SELECT 1 FROM mysql.user WHERE User = 'acme_x7k2_blog';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | CREATE USER 'acme_x7k2_blog'@'169.254.80.1' IDENTIFIED BY 'Abcdefghijklmnop1234' REQUIRE NONE WITH MAX_USER_CONNECTIONS 100;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON `acme\_x7k2\_blog`.* TO 'acme_x7k2_blog'@'169.254.80.1';

== SetDatabaseUser create
steps: Set user and password | Set access to databases
long: false
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | SELECT 1 FROM mysql.user WHERE User = 'acme_x7k2_app';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | CREATE USER 'acme_x7k2_app'@'169.254.80.1' IDENTIFIED BY 'Abcdefghijklmnop1234' REQUIRE NONE WITH MAX_USER_CONNECTIONS 100;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES, GRANT OPTION FROM 'acme_x7k2_app'@'169.254.80.1';
  | GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON `acme\_x7k2\_shop`.* TO 'acme_x7k2_app'@'169.254.80.1';
  | GRANT SELECT, SHOW VIEW ON `acme\_x7k2\_blog`.* TO 'acme_x7k2_app'@'169.254.80.1';

== SetDatabaseUser change
steps: Set user and password | Set access to databases
long: false
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | SELECT Host FROM mysql.user WHERE User = 'acme_x7k2_app';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | RENAME USER 'acme_x7k2_app'@'169.254.80.1' TO 'acme_x7k2_app'@'%';
  | ALTER USER 'acme_x7k2_app'@'%' REQUIRE SSL WITH MAX_USER_CONNECTIONS 100;
  | ALTER USER 'acme_x7k2_app'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'Abcdefghijklmnop1234';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES, GRANT OPTION FROM 'acme_x7k2_app'@'%';
  | GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON `acme\_x7k2\_blog`.* TO 'acme_x7k2_app'@'%';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | KILL USER 'acme_x7k2_app';

== SetDatabaseUser bad privileges
refused: the database privileges "all" are not valid

== DeleteDatabaseUser
steps: Remove user
long: false
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | SELECT Host FROM mysql.user WHERE User = 'acme_x7k2_old';

== Backup
steps: Snapshot files | Dump databases | Upload to object storage | Apply retention
long: true
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb-dump --user=root --single-transaction --routines --events acme_x7k2_shop
$ restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m cat config
$ /usr/local/bin/cf-agent jail --ro $DIR/sites/acme_x7k2/app --ro $DIR/data/dumps/acme_x7k2 --tmp $DIR/data/restic-tmp -- restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m backup $DIR/sites/acme_x7k2/app $DIR/data/dumps/acme_x7k2 --tag website=01JBQ3Z5K8N6T4W2X9Y7R5P3M1 --tag kind=manual
$ restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m forget --tag website=01JBQ3Z5K8N6T4W2X9Y7R5P3M1,kind=manual --group-by  --keep-last 3
result dumps: map[mariadb:acme_x7k2_shop:HEX64]
result forgotten: []
result sizeBytes: 2048
result snapshotId: 1a2b3c4d

== Backup of the databases only
steps: Snapshot files | Dump databases | Upload to object storage | Apply retention
long: true
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb-dump --user=root --single-transaction --routines --events acme_x7k2_shop
$ restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m cat config
$ /usr/local/bin/cf-agent jail --ro $DIR/data/dumps/acme_x7k2 --tmp $DIR/data/restic-tmp -- restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m backup $DIR/data/dumps/acme_x7k2 --tag website=01JBQ3Z5K8N6T4W2X9Y7R5P3M1 --tag kind=scheduled-databases
result dumps: map[mariadb:acme_x7k2_shop:HEX64]
result forgotten: []
result sizeBytes: 2048
result snapshotId: 1a2b3c4d

== Restore
steps: Download snapshot | Restore | Health check
long: true
$ restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m snapshots 1a2b3c4d
$ restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m restore 1a2b3c4d --target $DIR/data/restore/01JBQ3Z5K8N6T4W2X9Y7R5P3M2 --include $DIR/data/dumps/acme_x7k2/mariadb-acme_x7k2_shop.dump
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'cfdefiner_RANDOM'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'HEX24';
  | ALTER USER 'cfdefiner_RANDOM'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'HEX24' ACCOUNT UNLOCK;
  | GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON `acme\_x7k2\_shop`.* TO 'cfdefiner_RANDOM'@'localhost';
$ chown db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 $DIR/secrets/env-RANDOM
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i --env-file $DIR/secrets/env-RANDOM cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --sandbox --user=cfdefiner_RANDOM --batch acme_x7k2_shop
  | SELECT 1;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS `acme_x7k2_shop`;
  | CREATE DATABASE `acme_x7k2_shop` CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i --env-file $DIR/secrets/env-RANDOM cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --sandbox --user=cfdefiner_RANDOM --batch acme_x7k2_shop
  | DUMP OF acme_x7k2_shop
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | ALTER USER IF EXISTS 'cfdefiner_RANDOM'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'HEX24' ACCOUNT LOCK;

== Restore with a wrong hash
steps: Download snapshot | Restore | Health check
long: true
error: the dump does not agree with the hash from the backup
$ restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m snapshots 1a2b3c4d
$ restic --repo s3:b/c --password-file  --json --retry-lock 30m restore 1a2b3c4d --target $DIR/data/restore/01JBQ3Z5K8N6T4W2X9Y7R5P3M2 --include $DIR/data/dumps/acme_x7k2/mariadb-acme_x7k2_shop.dump

== databaseSizes
mariadb acme_x7k2_shop 4096
mariadb acme_x7k2_blog 8192
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | SELECT table_schema, COALESCE(SUM(data_length + index_length), 0) FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY table_schema;

== DeleteDatabase
steps: Remove access of users | Remove database
long: false
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | DELETE FROM mysql.db WHERE Db IN ('acme_x7k2_blog', 'acme\\_x7k2\\_blog');
  | DELETE FROM mysql.tables_priv WHERE Db IN ('acme_x7k2_blog', 'acme\\_x7k2\\_blog');
  | DELETE FROM mysql.columns_priv WHERE Db IN ('acme_x7k2_blog', 'acme\\_x7k2\\_blog');
  | DELETE FROM mysql.procs_priv WHERE Db IN ('acme_x7k2_blog', 'acme\\_x7k2\\_blog');
  | FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS `acme_x7k2_blog`;
  | DROP USER IF EXISTS 'cfdefiner_RANDOM'@'localhost';

== move secret
path: $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1/mariadb.env
"MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD=00112233\nMYSQL_PWD=00112233\n": line 1 of the secret of the mariadb superuser is not valid
"POSTGRES_PASSWORD=00112233\n": line 1 of the secret of the mariadb superuser is not valid
"00112233\n": line 1 of the secret of the mariadb superuser is not valid
"MYSQL_PWD=00112233\n": line 1 of the secret of the mariadb superuser is not valid
"POSTGRES_PASSWORD=0011\nOTHER=1\n": line 1 of the secret of the mariadb superuser is not valid
"": line 1 of the secret of the mariadb superuser is not valid

--- $DIR/units/10001/cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1.container (-rw-r--r--)
  # Managed by the Cloudfactory agent. The agent replaces changes to this file.
  [Unit]
  Description=Cloudfactory MariaDB database server 01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1

  ContainerName=cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1

  GlobalArgs=--runtime=/usr/local/bin/runsc --runtime-flag=platform=systrap --runtime-flag=network=sandbox --runtime-flag=ignore-cgroups
